summary.text: Cynthia Nations is the Democratic candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 55, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Matt Brown; she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Cynthia Nations ran in the 2024 general election for Arkansas House District 55 and lost to incumbent Matt Brown, 41.5 percent to 58.5 percent.
